name: Grilled Lime Shrimp with Black Bean, Corn, Pepper, Tomato & Feta Salad

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: If using wooden skewers, place 12-18 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 limes
6 tomatoes
1 ½ orange bell peppers
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Zest limes into a large bowl and set aside for later use. Juice limes into another large bowl, then add oil, maple syrup, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tbsp pure maple syrup
1 ½ tsp oregano, dried
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Drain and rinse beans. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Rinse corn under hot water (from the tap) to thaw, then add to the bowl and set aside.

If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: 1.02 kg raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Add shrimp to the bowl with the lime zest, season with salt and pepper, then stir to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Thread shrimp onto the skewers and place on a plate. (If you don't have skewers, you can cook the shrimp directly on the grill pan.)
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Working in batches, add skewers to the pan and cook, turning occasionally, until shrimp are cooked through, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, medium dice tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the beans and corn.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers. Add to the bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide shrimp skewers and salad between plates. Top salad with feta and enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (113 g) pkgs crumbled feta cheese

line_items.ingredient_name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen
